scope: Separate rider tick during crash animation, first ground contact, and free-rider motion. Captured collision world, all animation assets, child actor, optional complete particle pool and global timestep compared. Active particles and crossfade are connected when captured. Stopped airborne/crash-animation transitions remain unsupported; independently initialized ticks do not establish retained trajectory parity.
